scripts.db:link:staging: echo '📋 To link to staging, run: supabase link --project-ref <your-staging-project-ref>' && echo '   Get your project ref from: Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → General' && echo '   Example: supabase link --project-ref abcdefghijklmnop'
scripts.db:link:production: echo '📋 To link to production, run: supabase link --project-ref <your-production-project-ref>' && echo '   Get your project ref from: Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → General' && echo '   Example: supabase link --project-ref xyzabcdefghijkl'
scripts.db:push:staging: echo '⚠️  Ensure you are linked to staging project first (run: supabase link --project-ref <staging-ref>)' && supabase db push
scripts.db:push:production: echo '⚠️  Ensure you are linked to production project first (run: supabase link --project-ref <production-ref>)' && supabase db push
scripts.db:verify:discovery: supabase db execute --file scripts/verify_get_discovery_feed.sql || echo 'Note: If --file flag not supported, copy/paste scripts/verify_get_discovery_feed.sql into SQL Editor'
